'''2008 Canadian Nationals''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG national championship played on Saturday 2 August 2008 at the Le Chevalier store, 20b Valmont (corner of Notre-Dame), Repentigny, Quebec, with [[Marc Renaud]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-21984-316639">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316639#p316639 Canadian Nationals - info in first post], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192927/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21984.html Internet Archive]</ref> Four players took part; [[Pierre Dubreuil]] won all six of his games, and he and his son [[Philippe Dubreuil]] received the two byes into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22727-329509">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=329509#p329509 Official Results - Canada Nationnals], trooper shark, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194405/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22727.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22727-329547">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=329547#p329547 Official Results - Canada Nationnals], trooper shark, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (21 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194405/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22727.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organization ==

[[Scott Lingrell]] posted the announcement on 20 July 2008: six games of Swiss with a final confrontation, decklists mandatory, starting at 10:00 am.<ref name="sf-21984-316639" /> Asked why the Players Committee had approved the event so late, he wrote that the tournament team had just banned [[Patrick Dinelle]] from all sanctioned events for six months, and that it wanted to show the Canadian players that the playgroup should not be judged by one player's actions.<ref name="sf-21984-317162">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=317162#p317162 Canadian Nationals - info in first post], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192927/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21984.html Internet Archive]</ref> Cedric Simon added that the tournament director could not play in the event.<ref name="sf-21984-317223">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=317223#p317223 Canadian Nationals - info in first post], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (22 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192927/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21984.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Le Chevalier store, 20b Valmont (corner of Notre-Dame), Repentigny, Quebec<ref name="sf-21984-316639" />
* '''Dates:''' 2 August 2008<ref name="sf-21984-316639" /><ref name="sf-22727-329509" />
* '''Time:''' 10:00 am<ref name="sf-21984-316639" />
* '''Format:''' six games of Swiss with a final confrontation; decklists mandatory<ref name="sf-21984-316639" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Marc Renaud]]<ref name="sf-21984-316639" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Pierre Dubreuil]]<ref name="sf-22727-329509" />

== Results ==

The results were posted on 21 August 2008. Mathieu Bellavance came to the event without decks; since only three other players had come, he played with two borrowed decks, under the name of his friend Nicolas Boisly, who had planned to attend, and the results were first posted under Boisly's name. Patrick Dinelle spent most of the day with the players and brought additional prize support.<ref name="sf-22727-329509" /> The poster of the results asked whether the Dubreuils were the first father and son to qualify for the World Championship at the same event.<ref name="sf-22727-329547" />
